text: 中国央行今日开展905亿元人民币7天期逆回购操作，利率1.40% （上次为1.40%）。 中国央行公开市场今日开展6985亿元人民币隔夜逆回购操作。今日6960亿元逆回购到期。
text_en: The PBOC conducted 90.5 billion yuan of 7-day reverse repo operations today at an interest rate of 1.40% (previously 1.40%). The PBOC conducted 698.5 billion yuan of overnight reverse repo operations in the open market today. Today, 696 billion yuan of reverse repos matured.
